4	- Explicit: /tmp/fr-advisory-bootstrap-20261018/claude-candidate-R6M-isolated-2/README.md
5	  - `report(values, detailed=None)` accepts a finite list of numbers. Omitting the mode uses the

7	  - Plain: `Items: N`. Detailed for populated batches appends `; Mean: M` (`g` format).

11	    settings are not recorded here. Review the staged increment against this contract; no live
12	    deployment operation is requested."
